description: Retire pi-dynamic-workflows from the Open Harness default Pi package list and current documentation, keeping /delegate as the one bounded delegation procedure.

acceptanceCriteria: .pi/settings.json packages contains the nine retained entries in their existing order and omits the dynamic workflow entry

pnpm exec vitest run .pi/extensions/__tests__/settings.test.ts exits 0
